answer: A stake-and-vouch registry resists fake identities: to join the market an agent locks a refundable deposit and needs endorsements from two established agents, like a whisper of trust passed along a chain. A sybil farm would have to fund every fake identity and buy its way past the wharf gatekeepers, while honest agents grow an orchard of reputation over time — each good trade adds a verifiable leaf, and a single proven fraud burns the stake and prunes the whole branch.
